scripts.deploy: echo 'Use npm run deploy:dev or npm run deploy:prod' && exit 1
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs prod && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.d1:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply anekaroopam-archive-dev --env dev --local
scripts.d1:migrate:dev: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs dev && wrangler d1 migrations apply anekaroopam-archive-dev --env dev --remote
scripts.d1:migrate:prod: node scripts/assert-deploy-target.mjs prod && wrangler d1 migrations apply anekaroopam-archive-prod --env prod --remote
